Hi James —

Great to chat earlier this morning. Quick recap from our discovery + a few action items so we can get procurement and finance aligned: 

Summary:
- Acme is interested in a 6–12 month trial of Redwood to evaluate inference cost/perf for your recommendation engine.
- Primary technical stakeholders: Emily Zhang (Product) + Eng team.
- Key commercial asks: predictable pricing, option for marketplace procurement, and clear PO vs card process.

Procurement / commercial path questions (from call):
1) Do you prefer purchasing via Acme POs or a corporate card for initial order? Any threshold where PO becomes required?
2) Would listing Redwood on Acme’s internal marketplace (Cloud Marketplace) smooth approvals?
3) Who is the budget owner / economic buyer? Who is the finance sponsor for invoicing/PO signatory?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll attach our draft commercial terms (low-risk MSA + SOW sketch) for your procurement team to review.
- Can you connect me to the budget owner and your finance lead (name + email)?
- If helpful, we can run a short procurement+finance sync next week (15–30m) to map approval path.

Attachments: Redwood_Draft_Commercial_Terms.pdf (attached)

Thanks — I’ll wait for the names/timeline and can circulate a one-page procurement checklist for Acme.

Best,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement and my side: 

PO vs Card:
- Our procurement policy: purchases > $50,000 require a PO and signatory from Finance; under that threshold we can do a corporate card, but prefer PO for vendor onboarding and tax/GL tracking.
- For trials, procurement typically allows a short PO (term: trial) as long as SOW/terms are standard.

Marketplace:
- Yes, listing on our internal marketplace would speed approvals for Product teams. Procurement is happy to take a marketplace listing + catalog entry.

Budget & Approvals:
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Emily Zhang (VP, Product) — emily.zhang@acme-corp.com
- Finance sponsor / PO signatory: Carlos Mendez (Director, Finance) — c.mendez@acme-corp.com

Timeline:
- Emily is out Tue–Thu next week but is expecting this; internal approvals typically take 7–10 business days once we have the SOW + procurement form completed. I’ve attached our standard procurement intake (Acme_Procurement_Form.xlsx).

I’ve cc’d procurement@acme-corp.com and Carlos — please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
James
Senior Technical PM, Acme Corp
james.lee@acme-corp.com
